Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align on a Private/VPC architecture review: 

- Key asks I heard: dedicated VPC for inference, customer-managed subnets, KMS integration for keys, and audit logging retention policy (90 days minimum).
- Primary stakeholders: Bob Chen (CTO) and Raj Patel (Security).
- Suggested next step: 60–90 minute architecture review with our infra engineers to walk through network requirements, routing, and deployment patterns (on-prem vs VPC options).

Do any of these times work for your team next week?
- Wed, Oct 14: 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu, Oct 15: 2:00–3:30 PM PT

Marissa (solutions) and Nikhil (infra) are looped so they can lead the technical deep dive. If you prefer an earlier slot or need to include any additional folks (SRE, network), let me know and we’ll adjust.

I’ll share a short pre-read (SOC 2 excerpt + network diagram) once we lock the time.

Thanks,
